title: 전체 개발 이력 읽기 전용 Git 메타데이터 원장

navigation.pageBounds: The read-only API clamps a requested page to 1..max(1, totalPages) after filtering and sorting; the UI accepts only a safe integer in that range.

crossYearFixture.description: 서로 다른 연도·저장소의 커밋과 날짜형 요약 제목을 full hash와 ISO 시각으로 식별한다. ERP 차수·MSSQL 원장을 조회하거나 수정하지 않는다.

purposeStories.default: Plain Korean for non-coders: why needed, actual buttons/settings and what became easier; raw technical titles remain available only in explicit original-record views
purposeStories.narrative: Each change can carry grounded problem and result alongside the actual change; optional absent details are never inferred. Same-day story starts follow real timestamps, not alphabetic ids.
purposeStories.coverage: Every safe record assigned exactly once to a grounded purpose or explicit review-pending bucket
purposeStories.evidence: Full hashes and local documents validated at build/test, private references omitted from API
purposeStories.summaryEvidence: Only uniquely matched known-title source/date/title triples from reviewed notes; unstable list ids never determine meaning, ownership conflicts fail and internal explicit references are omitted from API
purposeStories.reviewNotes: Optional sanitized reasons use stable existing commit keys only, reject duplicates and unstable summary ids, and are projected only for unassigned records. Code integrations are not new feature outcomes.
purposeStories.sideEffects: Authenticated GET static metadata only; zero ERP reads or writes

journey.coverage: Same complete sanitized snapshot and selector as full-history, never only its first page
journey.grouping: Asia/Seoul chronological month and day, every selected event exactly once
journey.details: Existing authenticated full-history GET with identical filters, exact KST day, oldest order and pages of 50
journey.counts: Git changes, code integration records and work summaries remain separate; not requests, hours or deployments
journey.sideEffects: Read-only static metadata, zero ERP/SQL access

dnspyEvidence.source: nenova.exe 대응 기능이 아닌 웹 전용 정적 Git 메타데이터 조회. EXE 및 SQL에 접근하지 않는다.
methods: NenovaWeb withAuth GET static snapshot read

counting.unit: verified default-ref reachable Git commit record, not user request or hours
counting.global: exact full-hash union across source repositories; work summaries separate
counting.merge: parent count greater than one; counted separately from non-merge
counting.stage: external verified main refs plus current ERP build HEAD; ERP non-master build HEAD may include branch commits, explicitly disclosed; no working tree
counting.classification: parentless verified root or explicit subject prefix; otherwise unclassified
counting.safety: sanitized subject and allowlisted paths only; no author identity, body, diff, private session content, SQL, or ERP data
